Partly built

A partner rents GPU nodes to a room pool

A partner will list a node for a room's pool; the served-by line will name it and the earnings will go to payouts.

Partly built. Some of the steps below exist today and the rest are still to come. The lists at the bottom show which.

How it runs

  1. FactThe partner no tool neededLists a node for one room or workspace.
  2. PlanThe router via partnerSends the room's calls to the node when it fits.
  3. ReceiptThe turn no tool neededThe served-by line names the node; earnings are metered at its price.
What you get
Starts withA partner
StatusPartly built
Which node served each turn and what it earned.

What it keeps to

  • A node serves only the scope it was listed for.
  • Earnings stay separate from prepaid credit.
